subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Which session activity contract and Control UI scope should own the compact active-run progress surface requested by issue #52960?
rationale: The requested UI needs state beyond current status and hasActiveRun, and related open issues/PRs propose different API and presentation boundaries that require maintainer product/API direction.

options.title: Make the activity contract canonical first
options.body: Use the broader sessions.activity and WS statechange design as the source of truth, then build the compact Control UI strip on top of it.

options.title: Narrow an existing PR into the landing path
options.body: Adopt PR #96672 or #92697 only after trimming it to the agreed API/UX boundary and proof requirements.

options.title: Defer the progress strip
options.body: Keep the current coarse status UI until maintainers are ready to own the broader session activity semantics.

recommendation.title: Make the activity contract canonical first
recommendation.body: Use the broader sessions.activity and WS statechange design as the source of truth, then build the compact Control UI strip on top of it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-path Control UI session-status history among the checked related changes.
